items.title: 「Ratatan」はなぜ延期になったのか。15〜20人で4ハード10言語を作りきったTVTの開発事例［CEDEC 2026］
items.summary: 「パタポン」の精神的続編である「Ratatan」が，発売延期を経て，2026年10月15日に正式リリースされる。CEDEC2026の講演「Ratatanができるまで−小規模開発で4ハード10言語開発を達成した開発事例−」で，開発を手がけたTVTの2人は，4ハード10言語をどう成立させ，そして最後の最後で何をしくじったのかを，包み隠さず語った。

zh.title: 《拉塔坦》为何被推迟？ TVT 开发示例，其中 15 到 20 人创建了 4 种硬件和 10 种语言​​[CEDEC 2026]
zh.summary: 《Patapon》的精神续作《Ratatan》在推迟发行后将于 2026 年 10 月 15 日正式发行。在CEDEC2026讲座《Ratatan是如何被创造出来的——我们如何在小规模开发中实现4种硬件和10种语言的开发案例》中，两位参与开发的TVT人员公开谈论了他们是如何能够创建4种硬件和10种语言，以及在最后一刻出了什么问题。

en.title: Why was "Ratatan" postponed? TVT development example where 15 to 20 people created 4 hardware and 10 languages ​​[CEDEC 2026]
en.summary: ``Ratatan,'' the spiritual sequel to ``Patapon,'' will be officially released on October 15, 2026 after a release delay. In the CEDEC2026 lecture ``How Ratatan was created - A case study of how we achieved the development of 4 hardware and 10 languages ​​in small-scale development'', the two people from TVT who worked on the development openly talked about how they were able to create 4 hardware and 10 languages, and what went wrong at the last minute.

items.title: 「億万長者ゲーム」では，世界各地にビルを持ち，株取引で大儲け！ しかし最後に必要なのは……。 昭和・平成レトロボードゲーム大百科 第17回
items.summary: 昭和を代表するタカラ（当時）のボードゲームといえば「人生ゲーム」ですが，それに次ぐ存在と呼べそうなのが，今回の「昭和・平成レトロボードゲーム大百科」で紹介する「億万長者ゲーム」です。世界各地にビルを持ち，株取引で大儲けという，大人の雰囲気漂うゲームとなっています。

zh.title: 在《亿万富翁游戏》中，你可以拥有世界各地的建筑物，通过交易股票赚大钱！但你最不需要的是......昭和/平成复古棋盘游戏百科全书第17号
zh.summary: Takara（当时）昭和时代最具代表性的桌游是《生命的游戏》，但仅次于它的，是《百万富翁游戏》，我们将在这本《昭和平成怀旧桌游百科全书》中介绍它。这是一款带有成人气息的游戏，讲述的是玩家在世界各地拥有建筑物并通过股票交易赚大钱的故事。

en.title: In the "Billionaire Game", you can own buildings all over the world and make a lot of money by trading stocks! But the last thing you need is... Showa/Heisei Retro Board Game Encyclopedia No. 17
en.summary: The most representative board game of the Showa era by Takara (at the time) was ``Game of Life'', but the one that could be called second only to it is ``Millionaire Game'', which we will introduce in this ``Showa and Heisei Retro Board Game Encyclopedia''. This is a game with an adult atmosphere about players who own buildings all over the world and make a lot of money through stock trading.

en.title: Deep Sea Raft Escape: Multiplayer cooperative survival game "SHORE" officially debuts
en.summary: The latest work "SHORE" from independent game developer "Underdog" was officially announced today. Trapped in the middle of the vast sea, you and your companions ride on a fragile, physically realistic raft to survive together in a desperate situation. Facing storms, tsunamis, sharks and hunger, find your way home in this survival adventure game "SHORE" that supports 1-4 players. "SHORE" is committed to finding a unique gameplay balance between exciting survival gameplay and a relaxed sand sculpture atmosphere. Players need to work together to deal with raging tsunamis and ferocious sharks, and all kinds of outrageous and extreme weather will occur. en.title: 'Unacceptable': CTO responds to Xbox service outage

After emergency repairs by the team, the service was officially restored earlier today. Scott Van Vliet admitted that this lengthy outage is completely "unacceptable" and will announce details about improving platform services in the coming weeks. It is reported that the outage originated from an abnormality in an external authorization service last night. Since the operation of Xbox is extremely dependent on this external service, the exception directly caused some login scenarios to fail. Permission verification processes such as loading the complete game library and launching purchased games also failed. Some publishers that rely on the same system have also been affected, causing players to find glitches concentrated only in specific games. X

en.title: Roguelike card-building game “Nightmare Card” is scheduled to be released on August 19
en.summary: The roguelike card-building game "Nightmare Card" developed by Soneka Games is scheduled to be released on August 19. In this game that blends strategy, occultism, and psychology, players delve into the world of dreams. In the game against the nightmare, cleverly use the card effects and chain reactions to finally win. <For embedded content, please go to the core to view it> It is reported that the player's goal is to accumulate "awareness points" at each purchase stage. These points will help you enter a lucid dream state and defeat your inner demons in your dreams. As long as you defeat your inner demon in 7 consecutive nights, you can completely get rid of it - but be careful: if you fail once, the nightmare will come back to bite you everything. The cards symbolize the people and actions you come into contact with during the day. At night, these cards will reappear in dreams, with unexpected and bizarre interweavings between characters and behaviors, creating an absurd but real dream narrative.

ja.summary: 知らず知らずのうちに、「リーグ・オブ・レジェンド モバイル ゲーム」は 4 周年記念式典の幕開けを迎えました。 『リーグ・オブ・レジェンド モバイル』がローンチされた初日のことは今でも鮮明に覚えています。約束を長く待った後、私は楽々と友人 5 人を集めて、午後から真夜中まで遊びました。 4 年間で、「リーグ オブ レジェンド モバイル ゲーム」は私の生活に溶け込み、私の古い友人になりました。時には 1 日に十数のゲームをプレイしたり、何週間もゲームをクリックしなかったのに、友人からの電話でうっかり峡谷に戻ってしまうこともありましたが、そのゲームが携帯電話から消えることはありませんでした。 「リーグ オブ レジェンド モバイル」が 7 月 25 日に上海の西外灘ドリーム センターで 4 周年祝賀会と夏の決勝戦を開催すると知り、非常に興味深く現場に足を運びました。ジンクス VS ブリッツクランクの銅像が設置されると、人々は現場にチェックインして写真を撮るようになりました。太陽は明るく輝いており、黄浦江沿いの気温は36℃に達しました。正直に言うと、ここは屋内に入るにはあまり適した場所ではありませんでした。

en.title: "League of Legends Mobile" celebrates its fourth anniversary, the canyon is not only in the game
en.summary: Unconsciously, "League of Legends Mobile Game" ushered in its fourth anniversary celebration. I can still clearly remember the first day when "League of Legends Mobile" was launched. After a long wait for an appointment, I effortlessly gathered five friends to play from the afternoon to midnight. In four years, "League of Legends Mobile Game" has been integrated into my life and has become an old friend of mine. Sometimes I would play more than a dozen games in a day, or I might not click on the game for weeks, and then I would inadvertently return to the canyon because of a friend’s call—but it had never disappeared from my phone. When I learned that "League of Legends Mobile" would hold its 4th anniversary celebration and summer finals at the West Bund Dream Center in Shanghai on July 25, I came to the scene with great interest. The statue of Jinx VS Blitzcrank caused people to check in and take photos at the scene. The sun was shining brightly, and the temperature by the Huangpu River reached 36°C. To be honest, this was really not a suitable place to be indoors.

en.title: Weird story: If it’s a rainy night, a cucumber
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Ronaldinho's drawings are becoming more and more amazing (Photo / Ronaldinho) There are two rows of cucumbers, two rows of eggplants and two rows of kale planted in my vegetable garden. Kale was infested with pests a while ago. The cabbage caterpillars first ate the leaves into poles before being killed by imidacloprid, and then ate the poles into mounds. Fortunately, for some unknown biological reasons, they are only obsessed with these two rows of eggplants, which are twenty centimeters apart. They are good-looking and have no bug holes. There is a red maple outside the vegetable garden. It is nothing special, but there is a cucumber hanging on it. The cucumber climbed up on its own. It passed first the wooden frame, then the holly bush, and finally reached the fork of red maple branches. There is only one plant, with fan-shaped leaves and curly vines mixed in with the maple leaves, red and green crowded together. After a few days, a white cucumber appeared on it. It looked ten centimeters in diameter. I didn’t understand how the slender vine could carry nutrients to three meters.

zh.summary: Anthropic因使用盗版书籍开发AI克劳德而被一群作家起诉，但Anthropic与原告之间的和解提案于2026年7月27日获得批准。然而，法庭文件显示，Anthropic“从装订中剪切并扫描了数百万本印刷书籍，仅将它们用于AI训练，并丢弃了原件”，这引起了一些人的批评。阅读更多...

en.title: Concerns that rare books will be lost as Anthropic cuts and digitizes millions of paper books for AI learning, Elon Musk appeals that ``SpaceXAI will not do that''
en.summary: Anthropic was sued by a group of writers for using pirated books to develop AI Claude, but a settlement proposal between Anthropic and the plaintiff was approved on July 27, 2026. However, the court documents revealed that Anthropic had ``cut and scanned millions of printed books from the binding, used them only for AI training, and discarded the originals'', which has attracted criticism from some. read more...
